name: schemaemitter-run-target-list-limits
body: Run drops a duplicate target line by exact-case comparison of its repo-relative path, so one file listed in two letter cases on a case-insensitive filesystem is emitted twice; it reads each listed .sqlproj twice (its own pre-parse, then SqlProjectReader.Read), so a project changed between the reads can still throw; its moduleDirs comparison is exact-case on absolute paths, as csharplib's; and it adds 3 to byte offsets only for a UTF-8 BOM, so a UTF-16 or UTF-32 .sql file decodes correctly but its start/end are UTF-8 byte counts without its BOM bytes. Upgrade if the --targets producer can list case variants, when Read accepts the already-parsed projects, or if UTF-16/UTF-32 SSDT files must carry true file byte offsets.
